description: HP-22 is the official Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) for the Hamirpur subdivision in Himachal Pradesh. Managed by the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), this office handles the registration of private non-transport vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses for the local population. It is a critical hub for transport administration in the Hamirpur district, which is known for its high literacy rate and significant contribution to the state's educational and administrative sectors.
address: Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Hamirpur, District Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh - 177001
